title: The Cutting Edge: Week of July 5th
body:
**Highlights**
- The first-ever on-chain treasury tip on Edgeware has been disbursed to Ryabina for his crucial contribution of [@Edgeware_bot](https://t.me/Edgeware_bot) (on Telegram).
- We have an [AMA with Justin Murphy](https://t.me/heyedgeware/49281) representing the community-funded project ‘Exit Theory’ scheduled at 3 pm ET on 16th July.


**Ecosystem Updates**
- Community members who are interested in running bridge relayers or Chainlink’s oracle nodes on Edgeware, please reach out to ops@edgeware.agency.
- Community members who are interested in running [Webb Protocol](https://www.webb.tools/)’s transaction relayers on Edgeware, please reach out to drew@webb.tools.


**Governance**
- [Ryabina has been granted a treasury tip](https://edgeware.subscan.io/treasury_tip/0x38cc923da47b7d09862fea098a99ab647376e255242e359ae1a06ca5f4cb07b8) of 200000 EDGs by Edgeware Council for the @Edgeware_bot on Telegram, continuous maintenance of the same and support in general.


**Community**
- The Calendar of events has many items each week, meetings on NFTs, DAOs, chain strategy and governance- whatever you're interested in,[ take a look.](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1059-edgeware-community-calendar-add-to-your-gcal)
- Trending Community Research thread(s):
- [Developer Experience / YouTube Strategy - July 9th, 2021](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1428-developer-experience-youtube-strategy-july-9th-2021)


**Events**
- Upcoming AMA: [Exit Theory ft. Justin Murphy](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1415053627610202112?s=20)
- The next Edgeware All-Community call is scheduled for July 14, 2021. Each month, different individuals/entities from the agency, builder guild, different working groups and enthusiasts come together to speak on various essential topics, ideas and updates related to Edgeware. If you missed it, you can find the[ meeting notes with recordings here](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/987-
